text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)— In this historic 
race, what everyone is watching closest 
regarding Duramente is...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go say hello.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? To think you'd be the one reaching 
out to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A declaration of war... There's no way 
it's that. You have no reason to do such a 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That's why I came.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I accept your declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Do you believe it holds any value 
receiving that from the me of today?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I boldly challenged an overseas race, only 
to suffer a crushing defeat. And in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, I lost to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I only had momentum during the 
Junior Class... It seems I was just an 
early bloomer after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—The only time people saw me as your rival 
was back then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And... I am no longer who I was back then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And yet, how could you possibly think to 
challenge me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Because you are Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how dire the predicament, think 
through every possible path to victory."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The greater the adversity, the stronger 
she becomes. That's the kind of Umamusume 
Satono Crown is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Aren't you just aiding the enemy?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san. I will not take back what I 
just said.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"'I'm not the same person I was back 
then'— That's undeniably true, you know."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident! Today, I'll surpass you... 
and move forward!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Duramente-san. ...Please go easy on me, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That's the look I wanted to see. —I'll 
give you everything I've got in return.
